summary: The role's tasks/main.yml must include ansible.mcp_builder.common with tasks_from install_manager and generate_manifest; an optional check runs mcp_manage run <package> --help to verify the server.
questions: What tasks does a custom MCP role need?
How do I verify an MCP server installed in an execution environment?
What does install_manager do in ansible.mcp_builder?

answer_card.title: Minimum tasks for a custom MCP role
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
# roles/cfn_mcp/tasks/main.yml
- name: Include install manager tasks
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: ansible.mcp_builder.common
    tasks_from: install_manager

- name: Update MCP servers manifest
  ansible.builtin.include_role:
    name: ansible.mcp_builder.common
    tasks_from: generate_manifest
```
Optional check: `mcp_manage run {{ common_package_name }} --help`.
